notes.title: SERAPH – S4 Season Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a015a94d5b0989031ac180a889de7c2dfd509dbc.png[/img]
Dear Adventurers,

As the S3 Season draws to a successful close, our operations and development teams have been working tirelessly, analyzing extensive player feedback and seasonal data to refine and enhance the game experience. 
Over the past weeks, we have dedicated ourselves to delivering a richer, more balanced, and strategically challenging adventure.

With the dawn of the S4 Season, we are excited to unveil the core updates and new features coming your way:

[olist]
[*] Brand-New Guild GvG Mode: Resource Conquest War
A dedicated guild battlefield map, where guild members must defeat monsters and compete with rival guilds to capture resource territories in a large-scale PvP competition.
[*] Dimensional Rift: Multi-Layered Adventure Challenges
Enter the mysterious Dimensional Rift map to obtain powerful gear, blessings, and other unique rewards.
[*] New Difficulty Tier: T19
A new challenge level featuring formidable bosses and exclusive high-tier loot drops to push adventurers to their limits.
[*] Alchemy & Expanded Tradeable Items
[list]
[*] Craft powerful potions using materials gathered from Dimensional Rifts to enhance character attributes.
[*] A wider variety of tradeable items will now be available, enriching the in-game economy.
[/list][*] Equipment Black Market: Random Draw System
Spend gold or Chaos Stones to randomly draw equipment across various levels, adding an exciting layer of unpredictability and reward.
[*] Seasonal Abyssal Treasures
Throughout the season, adventurers can acquire Soul Crystals and other powerful items in Dimensional Dungeons to boost combat power.
[*] Dynamic World Level Adjustment System
Server-wide synchronized progression:
The World Level will dynamically adjust based on the average active player level within the server.
Players below the World Level will receive bonus EXP, helping them catch up quickly and stay competitive.
[*] Optimizations & Improvements
[list]
[*] Enhanced Anti-Cheat Measures – Upgraded detection and enforcement to ensure fair gameplay.
[*] Combat Experience Refinements – Smoother mechanics and improved responsiveness during battles.
[/list]
[/olist]
[h2]Version Release Roadmap
[/h2]Testing Phase: All features are currently undergoing intensive testing and bug fixing to ensure stability and quality at launch.

The S4 Season represents a bold step forward in team-based strategy, diverse growth paths, and challenging gameplay.

We can’t wait to explore this new chapter alongside you. Stay tuned to our official community channels for real-time updates and announcements!

Thank you for your continued passion and support!

SERAPH Operations Team
September 24, 2025

notes.title: SERAPH Guild War – “Lost Domain: Treasure War”
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f6c83a50428be2c5d1ee9e039f3d5cd98d6c427f.png[/img]

Dear Players,

As the dust of history stirs again upon the battlefield and the ancient ruins fall under the gaze of powerful factions, the grand-scale GVG confrontation — “Lost Domain: Treasure War” — is about to erupt in the new version of SERAPH! This is no ordinary resource grab — it's a clash of strategy, courage, and guild-wide coordination. Let us unveil the secrets behind this epic war for dominion!

[h2]🔥 Core Highlights: Redefining the Battlefield, Elevating Tactical Warfare[/h2]
[h3]▶ Dual-Phase System: Bid for Access + Strategic Treasure Raid[/h3]
[list]
[*] Eligibility Bidding (Days 1–2):
Guilds must bid guild funds during a 2-day auction to qualify. Only winning guilds can enter the battlefield. Smart resource allocation is key to victory!
[*] Strategic Grid Warfare (Days 3–14):
A dynamic 9×9 battle grid offers unique challenges each round. Starting positions, adjacent grid access, monster levels, and affix effects are randomized per round, ensuring no two wars are alike.
[/list]
[h3]▶ Multidimensional Warfare: Land Domination & Aerial Mirror Raids[/h3]
[list]
[*] Land Occupation:
Players can only attack adjacent tiles from their guild’s territory. Terrain blocking and flanking strategies are essential. Capturing high-level tiles grants buffs like Attack/Defense boosts, enforcing regional control.
[*] Mirror Ambushes:
Introducing the Mirror Guard system:
Players can station mirror versions of themselves on occupied tiles using daily action points. Enemies invading these tiles must defeat the mirror guard — which inherits the player’s live stats and skill combos (QWER style). Tactical revenge adds unpredictability to each clash!
[/list]

[h2]🎮 In-Depth Mechanics: Micro-Control Meets Macro Strategy[/h2]
[h3]▶ Chessboard Gameplay: Civilization Conflict in Every Tile[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grid Attributes:
Each grid has a level, icon, type (Spawn/Obstacle/Resource), and occupation requirements. 
[*] Examples:
[list]
[*] Otherworld Dungeons: Defeat a boss and guard mirror to claim the tile.
[*] Resource Points: Provide continuous benefits to all guild members once occupied.
[*] Obstacle Tiles: Cannot be claimed but can block enemy routes.
[/list]
[*] Occupation Rules:
[list]
[*] First-Capture Rewards: The first guild to conquer a tile earns exclusive loot (e.g., NFT Treasure Map Fragments).
[*]Point System: Guilds earn Lost Domain Points daily after meeting occupation thresholds (used for guild rankings); individuals earn Treasure Contribution Points for redeeming rare gear.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]▶ Dungeon Battles: The Ultimate Test of Strategy & Execution[/h3]
[list]
[*] Otherworld-Style Dungeons:
[list]
[*] Mechanics: Win by defeating the boss, which shares HP across the team and is affected by map affixes (e.g., Burning Ground = HP drain).
[*] Mirror Defense: If a tile has enemy guards, the battle becomes a gauntlet — beat the mirror before facing the boss. Requires high coordination and skill.
[/list]
[*] Timed Damage Instances:
[list]
[*] Mechanics: No boss defeat needed. Rankings are based on total damage dealt within a time limit.
[*] Strategy: DPS go all out, tanks manage aggro, and healers balance the team. One misstep can doom the entire attempt.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]💰 Rewards System: Personal Glory Meets Guild Supremacy[/h2]
[h3]▶ Guild Rewards: Strategic Resource Accumulation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guild Warehouse:
[list]
[*] Guild rewards (e.g., Lost Domain Chests, Strategic Blueprints) are stored and distributed by guild administrators. Rare rewards include:
[*] NFT Treasure Chests: Tradable digital assets.
[*] Guild Skillbooks: Unlock exclusive buffs (e.g., +Crit Rate for all members).
[/list]
[*]Ranking Announcements:
The Top 3 guilds by total points will receive a full-server broadcast and exclusive titles (e.g., “Supreme Landlord”).
[/list]
[h3] ▶ Personal Rewards: Heroism Recognized[/h3]
[list]
[*] Contribution Points System:
[list]
[*] Guild Contribution: Redeem rare guild shop items (e.g., War Banners, Construction Blueprints).
[*] Treasure Contribution: Exchange for epic gear (e.g., “Prophet’s Eye” accessory), and limited-time titles (e.g., “Treasure Vanguard”).
[/list]
[*] First-Capture Honors:
The first player to occupy a tile earns a permanent statue displayed in the guild base — visible to all across the server!
[/list]

“Lost Domain: Treasure War” is not just a PvP feature — it’s a living saga of history shaped by the players themselves.
When you command strategic positions, when your mirror fights valiantly in enemy ranks, and when you raise your guild’s banner on enemy grounds — that’s not just victory. That’s legacy.

⚔️ Let the war drums sound! Strategists, it’s time to etch your name onto the Lost Domain battlefield!

🔥 Launch Time: Second week after version update
📍 Participation: Guild Leaders can register at the “Strategic Officer” NPC


SERAPH Steam Operations Team

notes.title: Seraph – Notice on Optimized Rules for Premium Ascension Item Usage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/07bdf01650104b4407b0655fc86e7fddd2f38978.png[/img]
Dear players,

To further enhance the user experience and ensure fairness during character progression, we have implemented a comprehensive optimization to the **Premium Ascension Item** usage rules. These changes take effect immediately upon the release of this announcement.

[h2]1. Removal of Level Requirement
[/h2]
The level restriction for using the Premium Ascension Item has been removed. Players can now use the item regardless of their current character level.

Updated rules:
[list]
[*] If your character is below level 60, using the item will instantly raise them to level 60.
[*] If your character is already level 60 or above, your current level will be retained — no downgrade will occur.
[/list]

This adjustment allows players to use the item at any stage of their progression without restriction.

[h2]2. Reward Completion Mechanism
[/h2]
To protect players who may have previously used a Standard Ascension Item, we have introduced a Reward Completion Mechanism:
If the system detects that a character has already used a Standard Ascension Item and then uses a Premium Ascension Item, The system will automatically grant the remaining exclusive rewards included with the Premium version.
This ensures no duplication or loss of rewards, offering the full value to players.

We sincerely thank all players for your continued understanding and support. We will keep monitoring player feedback and strive to improve our features and systems.

If you encounter any issues while using the item, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us via our customer support channels — we are here to help!

Seraph Steam Operations Team

notes.title: SERAPH Steam Version – New Season FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/535b1e52d6e08f5cfcbbe13f65beb99b454da31a.png[/img]

[h3]1. How do I access the Steam version? How should I select a server?
[/h3]
Players can download the client via Steam. If you’ve played previous seasons, simply update the client through Steam.
There are four regional servers (Asia, Europe, North America, and South America). Choose the one with the best connection speed for optimal performance.

[h3]2. What is the schedule for this season?
[/h3]
The season begins on June 12 at 11:00 AM (UTC+8).
The end date will be announced via the official community channels.

[h3]3. Can I livestream, record, or share game content on social media?
[/h3]
Yes, as long as it complies with applicable laws, platform policies, and community standards.
However, unauthorized datamining, theft of assets, or defamatory actions are strictly prohibited, and legal action may be taken.

[h3]4. How can I obtain Soul Spears?
[/h3]
After reaching level 60 and equipping a Chaos Treasure, you can earn Soul Spears by completing Void Otherworld challenges.

[h3]5. What if an NPC or quest monster disappears and I can’t complete a quest?
[/h3]
Click your character avatar and leave the instance, then re-enter the map. This will refresh the NPCs and quest objectives.
(Note: Even solo gameplay uses instanced rooms.)

[h3]6. What if I can’t summon my pet?
[/h3]
Pets have time-limited usage. Please check the Pet menu for expiration details.

[h3]7. How do I claim new and returning player rewards?
[/h3]
All accounts, including new ones, will automatically receive:
Season Pass
Stall Permit (Season)
Ascension Item (Total value: $135 USD)

These are delivered directly to your character’s inventory.
Note: The Season Pass is not usable in the Steam version.
The Ascension Item for new users is a Standard Ascension Item.

Returning players can click “Welfare” > “Veteran Rewards” in the menu to manually claim their bonuses.
> Includes a Season Pass usable in Steam and a Premium Ascension Item.
> Each account may only claim this once, so choose the character wisely.

[h3]8. How do I use the reward items I received?
[/h3]
Season Pass: Unlock via the Season Pass interface.
Stall Permit: Activate through the stall setup menu.
Ascension Item: Right-click in your inventory to use.

⚠️ Only one Ascension Item (Standard or Premium) may be used per account. Once used, the other becomes unusable. Choose carefully.

[h3]9. Why is my previous season character missing?
[/h3]
The game uses a seasonal system. At the end of each season, all data is wiped.
For details, refer to earlier announcements.
Content eligible for inheritance can be found under “Welfare” > “Season Inheritance”.
> Please note: Inheritance must be claimed all at once, not partially, and must be claimed on the correct character.

[h3]10. How can I contact the official team during gameplay?
[/h3]
Players can submit feedback, suggestions, or bug reports (especially critical issues) via the Steam platform (email or forums). Significant contributions may receive special rewards.

notes.title: SERAPH Steam Version New Season Preview: The NPC AI Agent System!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

After months of dedicated development, the SERAPH team is proud to unveil a revolutionary feature arriving in the new season: the AI Agent System! Centered on the theme of “Deep Interaction and Emotional Connection,” this system empowers the game’s ecosystem through advanced AI technology—infusing the world of SERAPH with living, breathing personality.

[h2]1. Agent Unlocking: A Journey of Mutual Bonding[/h2]
All AI agent NPCs will be integrated into the new “Social – NPC Friends” interface. Unlocking them will grant access to exclusive interaction-driven storylines. Two immersive paths are available for unlocking:
[list]
[*] Story Resonance: Progress through key main/side quests to gradually reveal each agent’s backstory. (Players with Direct Upgrade privileges may unlock all story-linked agents instantly.)
[*] Challenge Certification: Complete trials specific to each agent—such as tactical simulations or puzzle challenges—to earn their recognition.
[*] Design Philosophy: Each agent is a unique narrative node; unlocking them marks the beginning of a personal epic in character development.
[/list]
[h2]2. Dialogue Challenges: The Art of Dynamic Semantic Interaction[/h2]
Once unlocked, agents can engage in Dialogue Challenges—these aren’t simple scripted conversations, but real-time semantic interactions based on dynamic language understanding.
[list]
[*] Intelligent Response System: Conversations will trigger key phrases or hidden emotional conditions (e.g., empathetic support, strategic persuasion) to progress. The AI parses and reacts to contextual depth in real time.
[*] Seasonal Reward Loops:
[list]
[*] First-time completion yields exclusive resources (challenges reset each season);
[*] Weekly Agent Care Plan: The system will randomly select NPCs you've completed to send personalized messages with season points or rare items—offering a meaningful “remembered by the NPC” experience.
[*] Optimized Interaction Frequency: Daily conversation limits ensure server stability and encourage consistent player engagement.
[/list][/list]
[h2]3. Technological Leap: A New Era of NPC Interaction[/h2]
This system combines emotional computing models with enhanced behavior decision trees to deliver:
[list]
[*] Personality Expression: Each agent has an individual personality matrix (e.g., aloof, calm, sly), and their dialogue strategies evolve based on your relationship.
[*] Contextual Memory: The AI retains cross-session preferences to generate evolving, persistent narrative branches.
[*] Low-Latency Interaction: Our proprietary inference engine ensures millisecond-level response time for a seamless, immersive experience.
[/list]

The new season will launch globally soon!
Our team is continuously enhancing the agent behavior library and narrative network. Upcoming features include AI Agents as Combat Companions and Cross-NPC Dynamic Events—stay tuned!

The SERAPH Steam Operations Team

notes.title: SERAPH Season End & Post-Season Operation Adjustment Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The current season of SERAPH officially concluded on April 10, 2024, and will be fully end on April 17. Following the season’s end, the Steam version will continue normal operation, but with several important feature adjustments and optimizations:

[h2]🔧 Post-Season Adjustments[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Steam Inventory Deactivation
To improve data management and account security, the "Steam Inventory" feature will be officially disabled after the season ends. Items stored in the inventory will no longer be accessible or transferable.
[*] Chaos Realm Mode Removal
The "Chaos Realm" game mode will be shut down. Players will no longer be able to access or enter this content.
[*] Ladder Mode Adjustments
The "Ladder" (Seraph’s Trial) system will remain available for gameplay, but no further rewards will be distributed moving forward.
[*] Void Abyss Mode Adjustment
After the season ends, the "Void Abyss" mode will remain playable; however, it will no longer drop Soul Spars. Please plan your in-game resource usage accordingly.
[/olist]

[h2]🗓 Adjustment Timeline & Future Plans[/h2]
These adjustments will remain in effect **until the start of the next season**. During this time, related features and content will be restructured and improved. A brand new season is in the works and promises **richer content and an enhanced gameplay experience**—stay tuned!

[h2]💾 Data Wipe Notice for the New Season[/h2]
To ensure a fair and smooth start to the next season, a full data reset will take place before it begins.
[list]
[*]Data that will be retained:
[list]
[*] Chaos Stones
[*] Season Points
[/list]
[*]Data that will be cleared: All other data, including but not limited to:  
[list]
[*] Characters and levels  
[*] Equipment and items  
[*] In-game currency  
[*] Ladder rankings
[/list]

notes.title: SERAPH Demo – Steam Next Fest Test FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3e724b0b91f05423054f8afa3349bc8c68c9cc40.png[/img]

1. What kind of test is the Steam Next Fest demo test?
The Steam Next Fest test is a free, data-wiped, and unrestricted test for PC players on the Steam platform.

2. Will the test server share data with other versions?
No, the test servers are exclusive to Steam, and data will not be shared with or carried over to any other servers.

3. How do I choose a server for the demo test?
The test will feature four server regions: Asia, Europe, North America, and South America. Players are encouraged to select a server based on connection speed for the best experience.

4. What are the test dates for the Steam Next Fest demo?
The test starts on February 24 at 11:00 AM (UTC+8). Please check official community announcements for the end date.

5. Can I share gameplay content (streams, recordings, screenshots) on social media?
Yes, as long as it complies with legal regulations and platform policies. However, data mining, unauthorized use, or malicious defamation of the game will be subject to legal action. Thank you for your understanding and support.

6. What should I know about Chaos Treasures?
During the test, players will receive Chaos Treasure Chests, which cannot be sold or discarded once claimed. They can only be dismantled, and any Chaos items obtained through dismantling will also be non-tradable and non-discardable. Since Chaos Treasures are distributed separately from regular loot, please ensure you have enough inventory space before claiming them via in-game mail.

7. How can I obtain Soul Crystals?
Players who reach level 60 and clear the Void Abyss while wearing Chaos Treasures can obtain Soul Crystals. Additionally, we will distribute Soul Crystals periodically throughout the test for players to experiment with.

8. What should I do if an NPC or quest enemy disappears, preventing me from completing a mission?
Click on your character portrait and exit the room, then re-enter the map to refresh it. (This also applies to single-player instances.)

9. What if I can’t summon my pet?
Pets have a limited usage time. Please check the pet interface for remaining time. The test provides pet duration items, which can be used from the inventory.

10. How can I contact the developers during the test?
Players can submit feedback, report bugs, and suggest improvements via the Steam platform (email or forum). We will actively review and respond to feedback, and special rewards may be given to those who make significant contributions.

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions about the SERAPH's Playtest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307172/fd79caf4364f2d31bd45dbde7bfe141372723f5e.jpg[/img]

1. What is the STEAM Playtest (Pioneer Test)?
Answer:
The Playtest is a test exclusive to PC users on the STEAM platform. It is free, limited in participant numbers, and data-wiped (limited means that test qualification must be applied for, but no activation code is needed).  

2. Does the Playtest server share data with other version servers?
Answer:
No, the Playtest servers are exclusive to STEAM and do not share or inherit data with any other servers.  

3. How do I select a server for the STEAM Playtest?
Answer:
This Playtest offers four regions: Asia, Europe, North America, and South America. Choose based on your connection speed to the servers for an optimal experience.  

4. How can I gain access to the STEAM Playtest?
Answer:
Request Playtest access via the SERAPH Playtest store page on STEAM. Once qualified, log in directly with your STEAM account — no activation code required.  

5. What are the dates for the STEAM Playtest?
Answer:
The start and end dates of the Playtest will be announced in the official community announcements.  

6. Can I share Playtest content on social media (e.g., livestream, record, or screenshot)?
Answer:
Yes, as long as you comply with laws, regulations, and platform rules. Content sharing, discussions, and dissemination are encouraged. However, we reserve the right to pursue legal action for unauthorized actions like data unpacking, theft, or deliberate defamation. Thank you for your understanding and support.  

7. What events are available during the STEAM Playtest?
Answer:
Refer to the official community announcements for event details. Notably, the Wishlist Rewards event will distribute rewards during the game's official launch phase. Prizes are abundant and practical, so we encourage everyone to participate actively.  

8. What should I do if NPCs or quest monsters disappear, making it impossible to complete a quest?
Answer:
Click your avatar, exit the room, and re-enter the map to refresh it (this works for solo games as well).  

9. What should I do if my pet cannot be summoned?
Answer:
Pets have a usage time limit. Check the usage time on the pet function page. Pet time extension items are provided in this Playtest and can be used from your inventory.  

10. How do I contact the developers during the Playtest?
Answer:
This Playtest is essential for preparing the official release version. Participants can provide feedback and suggestions about their gaming experience, particularly reporting major bugs. Use the STEAM platform (via email or forums) to contact us. Special contributions may receive unique rewards.

11. What should I do if specific files are flagged or deleted during the download, or if the game fails to launch after downloading?
Answer:
The Playtest package includes a dedicated anti-cheat system that might be falsely flagged by antivirus software. If you encounter such issues, temporarily disable your antivirus software and redownload the game package.

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (8) : Equipment
notes.content:
[h1]Basic Information about Equipment[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/11a6d9c5ba2a62c6a160c08f46e01cac66d23506.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Base Abilities[/b]
   These are the properties set when an item is obtained, which remain unchanged even if the equipment undergoes processing. The higher the item level, the more likely it is to have better abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f2d64f6a9037a5b539637748755f73ecb77ca712.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Equipment Quality (Item Grade) and Affixes[/b]
     In Seraph, there are four types of equipment quality, with the number of affixes that can be obtained varying according to the item's level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f88449d9e5738975f68f915fa0a67f0b77ebb249.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Affixes[/b] are divided into prefixes and suffixes. Depending on the item level, the maximum number of affixes that can be added is as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/09568346ed7e752e466de7814e84dca6b1953b3c.jpg[/img]
 
① Common and Unique quality equipment consist only of Base Stats and cannot have their affixes added or removed.
② Common quality equipment will definitely not have affixes, whereas Unique quality equipment can have up to 7 affixes.

[b]▶ Unable to Repaired[/b] : When general equipment durability is consumed, it can be repaired at a blacksmith NPC. But If there is a message, it cannot be used when durability is consumed.
[b]▶ Item Binding Status[/b]
     Even items of the same type can differ based on their binding status, categorized into character-bound, account-bound, and tradable items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a86ac0705ff4dcf9f26a303e9321b6152d628218.jpg[/img] 

[h1]Quality Forge[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/caec33d334fe2163ec8ee12df44c8e4f116894dc.jpg[/img]

▶ Equipment quality modification can increase the number of affixes based on the equipment's quality, adding one affix and thereby adding one attribute entry to the equipment.
▶ Even after modifying equipment quality, the equipment’s “Base Attributes” will not change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f485c9e3d3e840c6c025e082b779a75a3c2c07a0.jpg[/img]

▶ After a quality transformation, for example, from Magic to Rare, the prefixes and suffixes obtained when the equipment was Magic will not change, each increasing by 2 entries.
     ※ There is a certain probability that the affixes could end up being empty.
     ※ The amount of materials required varies depending on the item level. If the item level exceeds 60, a certain amount of soul crystals will also be required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/dc1cc9859cd5b49fac3b2d1a38e3d97765662dc7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Affixes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/27f3cf7aa03f0343321fe5a3c810f03e5a4861df.jpg[/img]

▶ Affix-related gameplay options include the following 7 types, which can be selected from the options on the right after inserting the equipment. 
    Choosing different gameplay options requires different materials:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5de372050a46aa55338fc13513ea08a37c29e558.jpg[/img]

▶ Once the equipment is placed, the required materials and their quantities will be automatically displayed. Material items can also be used in different binding states.
▶ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/dfecb2cd98cb4cc2a5cd3de192b81d0cf34e812e.jpg[/img]Clicking this button will show the possible attribute types and their probabilities.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/417eb45808251c4d6084520eaca23d7384ba4e7d.jpg[/img]

▶ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/a2f2372a8987eb2b174d451c84a00a2b58032023.jpg[/img]Clicking this button will provide detailed value ranges and their probabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/aa2e4af5720e3af051c08decbe01471ba8fb8511.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5f7d8aa50b27f02ba60d9fe4cd8c05b8e40dceb1.png[/img]

[h1]Forge[/h1]

▶ Materials related to equipment can be obtained through equipment disassembly, the quantity required varies depending on the item level.
▶ For equipment levels exceeding 60, a certain amount of Soul Crystals is also required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/f527749421fa7a5691f9abf24d585060a3911fc8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/8a52d40b1df8a51bd7867a4866292071f756c377.jpg[/img]

[h1]Salvage[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/8f0e8da38d529f2e3a2927a893f073d135f9ab89.jpg[/img]

▶ Equipment dismantling can be carried out by the [b]Blacksmith NPC[/b].

▶ When dismantling equipment, the materials obtained vary depending on the quality of the equipment, including [b]guaranteed materials[/b] and [b]materials obtained by chance[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3dde1331b1ad9eb5782bf9337c8b1802243ec46a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Skill & Item[/h1]

[b]▶ Choose equipment with attributes that increase skill levels![/b]
    If relying solely on skill points, each skill can only reach up to level 20. 
    However, if you have equipment with attributes that boost skill levels, then these skills can be further enhanced.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/c0186d5431267111627f6ea8e1da6cb9c4494148.jpg[/img]

[b]▶ Look for equipment with life or mana regeneration attributes![/b]
    During intense combat, it's easy to forget to drink potions, and your character could be killed by monsters as a result. Some equipment attributes allow you to recover some health or mana when killing or hitting monsters. If you fight with equipment that has these attributes, you can focus more on monster farming.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/110c9617912ee5ca1f71da6750ed02d21e0c9278.jpg[/img]


[b]▶ Although attack power itself is important, choosing equipment with attributes that increase overall speed from the start to the end of an attack, like attack speed, cast speed, and fast hit recovery, is better![/b]
     Equipment with high attack power is a good foundation, but items that may have slightly lower attack power but enhance the detailed attack process, like attack speed, cast speed, and fast hit recovery, could be more beneficial.
 
[b]▶ Don't forget to allocate skill points to skills with synergy bonuses! [/b]
    Investing in certain skills can enhance related skills. So, some skills may not be used directly, but assigning skill points to them can bring numerical improvements to commonly used skills. 
     For example, enhancing the Barbarian's "Quick Throw" skill will also increase the damage of the "Whirlwind Axe" and "Storm Throw" skills.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/7126393da0fca8e6137afe1c97f05d481d440f51.jpg[/img]

▶ A distinction of SERAPH from other MMORPG games is that, compared to the numeric values of equipment, the skills and the attribute entries of equipment are more important.

Players can decide which types of skills to develop based on their habits and the items they have acquired, creating gameplay routes that align with their own gaming preferences.

Additionally, SERAPH will adopt a seasonal operation mode. The SERAPH development team will continuously work on various aspects such as game balance, listen to the players' opinions, and co-create the future with the players.

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (6) : Class Introduction - Necromancer
notes.content:
[h1]A mad mage who defies taboos and warps life and death within his grasp. Capable of
fighting with curses and summons, as well as wielding polearm weapons for melee combat[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3774eb720ce1a70da3da3659c77d8ae4207ee3e5.jpg[/img]

Necromancers can use scythes, wands (staves), and shields. Wands can be combined with shields, or polearms can be used, depending on the main skill tree chosen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5b94611102ad03898c8a81c664dae82ad969148f.jpg[/img]

Attribute Allocation : The method of allocating points for a Necromancer depends entirely on the main skills used. For spellcasting and the Crimson Curse series of skills, mainly add points to Energy; for the Bone Shadow series, the focus should be on Agility and Stamina. The Blasphemous Legion series also requires investment in Strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/df0348eb568a08ed16779fc7fcd4a52c487b049d.jpg[/img]

Skill Points : For a more relaxed gameplay focusing on spellcasting, allocate more points into the Crimson Curse skills; for those seeking thrilling melee combat, points should be added to the Bone Shadow skills.

Necromancer's All Skill Tree are as follows:

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (5) : Class Introduction - Sorceress
notes.content:
[h1]Sorceress are masters at manipulating the elements of fire, lightning, and frost.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/44c6f25ff3bfa673336abc05c33ae5879e9f2e12.jpg[/img]

Sorceress primarily use orbs and staves for combat, focusing on casting spells. 
Since the attack relies on spells, physical attack power of the equipment does not impact combat performance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/05229587c8698961ef3aaec5f83d91e1c1d5cd53.jpg[/img]

Attribute Allocation : Spellcasting consumes a lot of mana, so it is recommended to mainly allocate points to 'Energy.' In the mid to late game, due to armor requirements and vitality needs, it's advisable to also allocate a reasonable amount of points to 'Stamina’ and 'Agility.'

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/683db7c110f6d1255d9404ae9736aa8889bb674b.jpg[/img]

Skill Points : Sorceress have access to frost, lightning, and flame skill trees, with no single "best" path. The choice of skills should be based on personal playstyle preferences and the affixes of the equipment. Among these, the frost skills, which can freeze enemies, are particularly useful.

notes.title: Guide for SERAPH's New Beginners (4) : Class Introduction - Barbarian
notes.content:
[h1]Barbarians possess unparalleled close-combat and weapon handling abilities.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3e1802e5be92b95b37e6b021be06cecd6d00e14d.jpg[/img]

Barbarians can use all types of weapons except those exclusive to Valkyries. However, considering their skills, they mostly use weapons like swords, axes, and hammers. The most effective weapon for them is the "Throwing Axe", because it can be used for both ranged attack  skills and two-handed weapon
attack skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/168221bcf45b9fad99a03beac17a171b36403525.jpg[/img]

Attribute Allocation : Since barbarians are mostly physical attackers, attribute points should mainly be allocated to ‘Strength’ which allows the equipping of stronger weapons. Additionally, investing some points into ‘Stamina’ can increase the health points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/2441fff1d25fa633afe059eb42235edcf658b4cc.jpg[/img]

Skill Points : The ‘Throwing Axe’ among thrown weapons can utilize both throwing skills and other melee skills, whereas other weapons like swords and axes cannot be thrown. Therefore, focusing on the "Master of Combat" skills can be more efficient for growth.

notes.title: [SERAPH : In the Darkness ] Game main description
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/5f6e0ea4338ec732dbfc68c4e30856a80692e5dd.gif[/img]

В "Войне Света" между Ангелами и Дьяволами Ангелы сотрудничали с людьми, чтобы запечатать Дьяволов в аду. Однако с течением времени человеческие желания стали неудовлетворимыми, что привело к бесконечной войне, поглощающей мир. Эта война породила ненависть среди людей, постепенно ослабляя печать на Дьяволах. В конечном итоге печать была разрушена, и мир оказался на грани уничтожения из-за Дьяволов. В эти бурные времена начался поиск героев, способных победить Дьяволов и спасти разрушающийся мир.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/1e93eb14ec325d662abd2ae363acf2ef7c1bd302.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Customize Your Playstyle[/b][/h3]
You can distribute character attributes and skill growth according to your personal preferences and playstyle. Additionally, you can customize your character's growth by crafting unique item properties, changing options, and crafting gems to suit your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/b115f47163dd72a2aeeb4d9a46f6086ddcddbc7b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Easy-to-Grasp 'Hack and Slash' Combat System[/b][/h3]
The controls are straightforward, but the game offers exhilarating combat with powerful actions and thrilling impact. Utilize a variety of fantastic combat skills to engage in fierce battles with diverse enemies and experience the pinnacle of combat action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/3522b72c65c6f1aed38f0868f56f5692196aa31a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Item Farming Based on Single or Party Play[/b][/h3]
Unlike traditional MMORPGs, you won't experience stress from indiscriminate player-versus-player combat (PK). You can progress through quest-focused gameplay on your own while farming for items, or you can form parties with like-minded players to tackle dungeons for faster item farming. Seraph provides enjoyable gameplay whether you play solo or with others, without the stress of PK.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/362fbe157553f563773aa182e113e777fbeec6ab.gif[/img]
